# Version 4.150.4 (Unreleased)
> **m150 servicing update**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.150.4 incorporates the latest upstream Chrome m150 rendering fixes. It also makes the native HarfBuzz package pass Windows binary analysis without changing its runtime behavior.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Chrome m150 fixes incorporated** — Updates the bundled Skia renderer with upstream m150 servicing and bug-fix changes. ([#5113](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5113), [#5083](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5083))
